summary: iTonic Holdings Ltd, a Beijing-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a 16-for-1 share consolidation (reverse stock split) of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, plus a related authorized capital increase. The consolidation takes effect 12:01 a.m. ET on October 6, 2026, pending Nasdaq non-objection, with post-split trading under symbol ITOC and new CUSIP G71399110. Outstanding Class A shares fall from 109,382,000 to about 6,836,375 and Class B from 7,668,000 to about 479,250. The action targets Nasdaq's US$1.00 minimum bid price rule, with a compliance deadline of October 19, 2026; no deal terms, pricing, or advisors are stated.
